 .
 (BY SMT. PRIYANKA MISHRA - GOVERNMENT ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.11/2024 dated 23.01.2024 registered at Police Station Sagra District Rewa for the offence punishable under Section 376 of IPC.
2.
Leaned counsel for the applicant contends that the present case pertaining to an incident dated 02.12.2023, the FIR has been lodged with a delay of one month.
It is contended by the counsel that the statement of the prosecutrix so recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. makes it crystal clear that the applicant as well as prosecutrix were in relationship.
It is contended by the counsel that the prosecutrix on her own volition came along with the applicant and they stayed together as well.
It is also contended by the counsel that the FSL report is negative and the applicant himself is aged about 23 years and he is in custody since 23.01.2024 deserves to be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent has opposed the prayer and submitted that the marriage of the prosecutrix was fixed elsewhere, however, the present applicant persuaded the prosecutrix to enter into wedlock as a result of which, the marriage which was already scheduled had to be cancelled, yet the present applicant did not make any effort to enter into wedlock and committed rape upon the prosecutrix, hence no case for grant of bail is made out.
4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
5. A perusal of case diary and the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C reflect the relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix.
The prosecutrix is major.
The applicant is aged about 23 years and he is in custody since 23.01.2024.
The FSL report is negative.
6. Thus, taking into considering the totality of the circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered view that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.

8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of the Cr.P.C.
9.
Accordingly, M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
